links.outcome: Repeatability of AI scores across 5 runs with different random seeds
links.effect: ABA ICC(3,1) 0.77 (o1) and 0.82 (GPT-5); coefficient of variation 6.6% for ABA vs 13.9% for human raters; ICC(2,1) 0.38 for humans.
links.quote: The coefficient of variation for ABA was approximately half that of HBA (6.6% vs 13.9%).
